priority: P1 — garantir idempotência de ações Discord 2v2: uma entrega duplicada com o mesmo interaction ID e payload não pode avançar o duelo, duplicar eventos ou gravar outro recibo.

behavior.firstDelivery: The active physical seat selects a legal action through the emitted TagDuel Discord component; one state revision, one receipt and one transition-event set are committed.
behavior.duplicateDelivery: The same interaction ID, actor, guild, revision and action is replayed after persisted-state reload; state, inventory, events, receipt count and committed revision remain unchanged.
behavior.requestIdCollision: Reusing the same request ID for a different action is rejected before edit/refresh and leaves the duel unchanged.
behavior.payload: Real Discord builders and handler produce valid private/public payloads offline.
behavior.conservation: All physical UIDs and card identities remain unchanged except for the intended first action; duplicate replay does not create or lose cards.

security.database: SQLite temporário com tabelas reais tag_action_receipts e tag_transition_events
security.discord: handler/builders reais offline; sem token, guild ou canal real

limitations: Não chama a API Discord real; simula entrega duplicada no handler real.
A suíte não modifica runtime nem concede inventário.
